entries.title: Shape-language system

inputs.purpose: Name the character or environment function that shape should express.

entries.outputIntent: A coherent shape grammar shared by characters, props, and environments without copying a named studio style.
guidance: Assign a small set of dominant shape families and connect each to story function or emotional read.
Repeat the grammar across silhouette, prop design, and architecture while preserving role-specific contrast.
Use asymmetry selectively to add life without destroying the dominant silhouette.
verifyCriteria: Major silhouettes remain identifiable without surface detail.
Repeated shapes have a consistent narrative meaning across asset classes.
incompatibilities: A prompt defined primarily by a named studio or artist
Surface detail used to compensate for an unreadable silhouette

entries.title: Controlled material simplification

inputs.purpose: Rank materials by story importance and recognition need.

entries.outputIntent: A simplified material system that supports form, hierarchy, and emotional tone.
guidance: Reduce micro-detail while retaining the cues needed to distinguish material classes.
Concentrate texture and specular complexity on story-relevant surfaces.
Keep broad value separation intact before adding color variation.
verifyCriteria: Materials remain distinguishable at the intended framing scale.
Detail density follows narrative importance rather than uniform realism.
incompatibilities: Material cues that obscure silhouette or expression

entries.title: Emotive color and light

inputs.purpose: Define the emotional change the palette and light must express.
Identify the subject whose read the lighting must protect.

entries.outputIntent: A stylized palette and lighting progression that supports emotional change and focal clarity.
guidance: Map palette shifts to story states rather than decorating every scene independently.
Use motivated direction plus controlled exaggeration to model readable forms.
Protect face, gesture, and silhouette before atmospheric richness.
verifyCriteria: The palette change corresponds to a declared story change.
The focal subject remains readable against the environment in value and color.
incompatibilities: Independent scene palettes without an arc
Atmosphere that erases the focal read

entries.title: Camera as scale and empathy

inputs.purpose: Identify whose scale and emotional access organize the shot.

entries.outputIntent: A stylized camera plan that uses scale, distance, and movement to align empathy.
guidance: Set camera height and distance relative to the empathy subject, not an abstract neutral observer.
Use foreground scale cues to make miniature, monumental, or intimate space legible.
Reserve exaggerated perspective for a specific emotional or spatial beat.
verifyCriteria: The intended scale reads from composition without explanatory text.
Perspective exaggeration has a declared emotional or spatial purpose.
incompatibilities: Camera scale that contradicts the intended empathy subject

provenance.adaptation: Rewritten as a generic stylized-3D and animation craft library. Brand, title, artist, and provider-specific imitation instructions were deliberately excluded.
